Assertion $A: \left[6\right]$ Annulene. \left[8\right]$~Annulene and cis $- \left[10\right]$~Annulene, are respectively aromatic, not-aromatic and aromatic.

Reason $R$: Planarity is one of the requirements of aromatic systems.

In the light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below.

$
options: Both $A$ and $R$ are correct and $R$ is the correct explanation of $A$.

questions.solution:

If this annulene with five cis double bonds were planar, each internal angle would be $144 °$. Since a normal double bond has bond angle of $120 °$, this would be from ideal. This compound can be made but it does not adopt a planar conformation and therefore is not aromatic even though it has ten $\pi$ electrons.

questions.q: Lassaigne's test is used for detection of:
questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.solution:
Lassaigne's test helps to detect Nitrogen, Sulphur, and Halogens in organic compounds. Here, sodium metal \left(Na\right)$ is heated in the presence of the organic compound inside a fusion tube. The primary objective of this test is that all the available elements are converted by Sodium metal \left(Na\right)$ into the ionic state. Lassaigne test reaction for sodium is given below:

$N + Na + C \to NaCN$

$S + 2Na \to {Na}_{2}S$

$X + Na \to NaX$

In the third experiment, $X$ can be anything such as $Cl, Br$ or $I$.

questions.q: Three organic compounds $A, B$ and $C$~were allowed to run in thin layer chromatography using hexane and gave the following result (see figure). The ${R}_{f}$~value of the most polar compound is _____ $\times {10}^{– 2}$
questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.solution:
In thin layer chromatography using hexane, the least polar compound will rise to maximum height and most polar compound will rise to minimum height.

The retardation factor of each spot can be determined by dividing the distance that a particular compound has travelled by the distance between solvent front and initial spotting site. This parameter is dependent on the thin layer chromatographic& plate and the solvent.

$∴ {R}_{f}$~value for most polar compound

$= \dfrac{2}{8} = 0 . 25$

$= 25 \times {10}^{- 2}$

questions.q: Kjeldahl's method was used for the estimation of nitrogen in an organic compound. The ammonia evolved from $0 . 55g$ of the compound neutralised $12 . 5mL$ of $1M{H}_{2}{SO}_{4}$ solution. The percentage of nitrogen in the compound is (Nearest integer)
questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.solution:
Meq of ${H}_{2}{SO}_{4}$ used by ${NH}_{3} = 12 . 5 \times 1 \times 2 = 25$

$%$ of $N$ in the compound~$= \dfrac{25 \times {10}^{- 3} \times 14 \times 100}{0 . 55} = 63 . 6$

or

Meq. of ${H}_{2}{SO}_{4} =$ Meq. of~${NH}_{3}$

$12 . 5 \times 1 \times 2 = 25meq$~of~${NH}_{3}$

$= 25$~millimoles of~${NH}_{3}$

So Millimoles of~$N ' ' = 25$

Moles of~$N ' ' = 25 \times {10}^{- 3}$

wt. of~$N = 14 \times 25 \times {10}^{- 3}$

$% N = \dfrac{14 \times 25 \times {10}^{- 3}}{0 . 55} \times 100$

$= 63 . 66$

$\approx 64 %$
